تناغمت (form VI)
# تَنَاغَمْتُ (tanāḡamtu) /ta.naː.ɣam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# تَنَاغَمْتَ (tanāḡamta) /ta.naː.ɣam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# تَنَاغَمْتِ (tanāḡamti) /ta.naː.ɣam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# تَنَاغَمَتْ (tanāḡamat) /ta.naː.ɣa.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
